title: Polish Grave Accord first-time play, language choice and multiplayer
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord has a cooperative boss-fight loop with seven classes,378skills,28weapons,66bosses,six maps and five modes. Offline Solo,public/private waiting rooms,host-only Start,optional passwords,profiles,encounter-boundary saves and authority-written team records are implemented.

The latest pass adds an explicit first-visit language choice before the home menu. All 15options use native language names and bundled script fonts; Continue saves, while existing valid preferences skip the page. The automatic display name uses the language at a fresh New run/Start gently/Join setup boundary and stays fixed through language, back-step and visibility changes in that setup. Empty names keep its original fallback. Typed names are never translated. Profile/import cancellation, explicit cosmetic-versus-import preference intent, editing position and startup fallback remain.

Exact source **402727baaf854a3dce67baadcc0d90f5e0a780e3**, build **2026.10.30-first-language/protocol43**, passes **906 local tests, 906 pass, 0 fail**, plus TypeScript,authored content/fifteen catalogs/native artwork,production build and71atlas contracts. Both exact-source GitHub jobs pass all 906 tests: [124218688902](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/41101241524/job/124218688902) and [124218634153](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/41101220114/job/124218634153). Complete decoded logs are preserved. [Scoped source and review evidence](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/tree/feat/first-playable-loop/reviews/first-language-2026-10-30). Fresh testing5252/backend2626 and public5253/backend2627 each pass 49 served hashes including all 15catalogs and actual two-peer protected-room/code/Japanese-Arabic-name/chat/pause/host-transfer/end/record checks. Wiki **68a93647575dee891186a2029dc9f9da6a8617eb** matches all 18 pages/34 images and public response hashes.

The matching local Windows review uses the same clean source. All 1899 files pass before/after six native offline/LAN diagnostics across original, fresh verified extraction-r02 and independent Japanese-path Windows copy. The 842946128-byte ZIP has SHA256 **18c91ea04604be068c46be7efca4b1eb1ac67369bed54d26adbfe07947d48c36**. [Exact package/delivery evidence](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/tree/feat/first-playable-loop/reviews/windows-first-language-2026-10-30) preserves the premature first extraction/native failure and complete successful second extraction separately. Earlier897-check source8368410, its sealed ZIP and every older artifact remain preserved.

The accepted gallery,full boss/survivor camera framing,clear Toad cover routes,pit-only lava,stable corner controls,five-second defeat beat,finite Medic recovery and difficulty shield rules remain. Online menus are personal; only the host deliberately pauses/continues,departure resumes and transfers controls,and End game for everyone is separately confirmed. Chat retains drafts until server confirmation.

This remains development work. Human/rendered/device/listening/native-language,complete action art,physical second-computer LAN,WAN/endurance/capacity and shared hosted ranking/recovery acceptance remain separate. Browser automation is disabled. Alternate cover art,bots/story and new gameplay expansion stay deferred. This draft does not merge main,deploy the game,replace the older hosted Site/Windows release or submit the contest.
